company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Regulated utility earnings remain profitable; raised guidance despite modest Q2 operating-EPS decline.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Large grid/generation buildout is capital intensive and requires debt/equity funding, while regulated recovery supports capacity subject to credit and affordability.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: Large-load/data-center demand creates prospective grid investment; realization depends on interconnection, generation, permitting and customer commitment quality.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Capital program aligns with load growth while regulatory recovery and financing discipline are central tests.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Regulated rate recovery provides structured economic capture rather than unconstrained pricing.
company-underwriting.catalysts: Large-load conversion, transmission/generation approvals, rate-base additions and guidance execution.

thesisQuality.basis: Essential regulated grid assets, rising large-load demand and visible rate-base investment support durable value capture.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Profitable regulated operations and raised guidance are tempered by modest Q2 EPS decline and heavy capital needs.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current market context supports reasonable but not distressed valuation for regulated growth.

catalystScore.basis: Large-load commitments, grid approvals and rate-base deployment provide multiple identifiable multi-year catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Regulated capital allocation is disciplined by commissions and guidance, though execution across a large buildout remains material.

alignment2036.basis: Transmission, distribution and generation are foundational infrastructure for electrification, industry and compute demand.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Generation, transmission and distribution serve residential, industrial and data-center demand across multiple states.

bottleneckControl.basis: AEP controls regulated grid infrastructure and interconnection pathways where capacity is a real constraint.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Essential utility demand and geographic/customer breadth are robust while rate, load-growth and financing scenarios matter.

substitutionResilience.basis: Regulated wires and grid interconnection are difficult to bypass at scale even when generation technologies change.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Scale provides planning flexibility, but turbines, transformers and permitting remain meaningful bottlenecks.

pricingPower.basis: Approved rate-base returns and cost recovery provide structured value capture constrained by affordability and regulatory review.
